historical_commentary.text: The iCalendar (.ics) format this note discusses is still a widely used, actively relevant standard today for calendar interoperability (used by Google Calendar, Outlook, Apple Calendar, and others), so the core integration goal remains valid, even though the specific 4D-side implementation details from 2003 have likely been superseded by newer 4D XML/text parsing commands or third-party components.
related_updates: The iCalendar (.ics) standard remains in wide, active use today across calendar applications
4D has since gained more general text/XML parsing capabilities that could simplify iCalendar data handling compared to 2003-era techniques
